notes.title: Air Brawl 1.01 patch notes
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/m2forMy.png[/img] 

Text: 

TDM win count decreased to 25

FFA win count decreased to 15

Flag pickup guitar riff volume decreased by 50%

Fixes:

Fixed bug where long server names would cover the server map name.

Fixed bug where game would crash when quitting.

Removed white cube from park. The cube was used to show the scale of a human and was left in the game by mistake.

Fixed bug where playing a game and then playing the tutorial would display the online escape menu in the tutorial.

Fixed bug where blinding light would only blind a part of the vikings vision.

Maybe fixed bug where the "Meet your maker" and "Slayer of gods" achievements would not be rewarded when killing/getting killed by devs.

Fixed bug where info texts when joining a server would block each other

notes.title: Air Brawl 0.1.9.3 released!
notes.content:
Features:

Mjölnir
A new primary weapon for the viking.

Holy shields
A new secondary for the cyber priest.

Exit button on map vote screen

Map/game mode button displays selected map/game mode

New text that displays information when joining a server.

Added a tunnel through the park.

Performance improvements on park and stronghold.
